Route matching with ten or more converters in one path segment must assign every captured value to its intended argument in numeric converter order. import importlib.util
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
import werkzeug
import importlib

MODULE = 'werkzeug.routing.matcher'
importlib.import_module(MODULE)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(MODULE, Path('src/integration.py').resolve())
candidate = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[MODULE] = candidate
spec.loader.exec_module(candidate)


from werkzeug.routing import Map,Rule,BaseConverter
import werkzeug.routing.map as map_module
from werkzeug.exceptions import NotFound,MethodNotAllowed
from werkzeug.routing import RequestRedirect
map_module.StateMachineMatcher=candidate.StateMachineMatcher

class NamedConverter(BaseConverter):
    regex=r'(?P<unrelated>[a-z]+)'

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reported_eleven_integer_converters(self):
        for count in [10,11,12,21]:
            route='/'+'-'.join(f'<int:a{i}>' for i in range(count))
            bound=Map([Rule(route,endpoint='e')]).bind('example.test')
            self.assertEqual(bound.match('/'+'-'.join(str(i+10) for i in range(count))),('e',{f'a{i}':i+10 for i in range(count)}))
    def test_mixed_types_and_segments(self):
        route='/<int:prefix>/'+'-'.join(f'<a{i}>' if i%2 else f'<int:a{i}>' for i in range(12))
        args={f'a{i}':str(i+20) if i%2 else i+20 for i in range(12)}
        bound=Map([Rule(route,endpoint='e')]).bind('example.test')
        self.assertEqual(bound.match('/7/'+'-'.join(str(i+20) for i in range(12))),('e',{'prefix':7,**args}))
    def test_custom_named_group(self):
        route='/<named:first>-'+'-'.join(f'<int:a{i}>' for i in range(11))
        bound=Map([Rule(route,endpoint='e')],converters={'named':NamedConverter}).bind('example.test')
        self.assertEqual(bound.match('/abc-'+'-'.join(str(i) for i in range(11))),('e',{'first':'abc',**{f'a{i}':i for i in range(11)}}))
    def test_small_normal_route(self):
        bound=Map([Rule('/<int:x>/<name>',endpoint='e')]).bind('example.test')
        self.assertEqual(bound.match('/2/hi'),('e',{'x':2,'name':'hi'}))
    def test_errors_and_redirect(self):
        bound=Map([Rule('/<int:x>/',endpoint='e',methods=['GET'])]).bind('example.test')
        with self.assertRaises(RequestRedirect): bound.match('/2')
        with self.assertRaises(NotFound): bound.match('/bad/')
        with self.assertRaises(MethodNotAllowed): bound.match('/2/',method='POST')

if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
